coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Counting 18 ground-truth items individually, 6 have matches: A100 hardware, fp16 precision, shared seeds/configuration, no lookup, mean-based unit representation, and accuracy measurement. Hardware and precision appear in feasibility estimates rather than explicit experimental controls.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output substitutes Llama-3 for Mistral and a 1024-token window for 4K. It changes or omits all five required memory settings. Its lookup conditions do not reproduce the encoding-plus-decoding versus decoding-only comparison, and token-level storage is not the required representative-token selection. It replaces Retrieve.KV, Math.F, and the specified QA task with other benchmarks. Mean pooling is included but incorrectly described as canonical and also applied to values.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It provides no finding that full memory lookup improves performance, removing lookup nearly collapses Retrieve.KV accuracy, or representative-token selection outperforms mean representation.
